categories.main_business_segments: Cathay Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates in real estate development, including residential and commercial building development, urban renewal, and land development. The company also engages in construction management, property sales and leasing, and diversified investments in related sectors such as health management, hospitality, and retail. Its business scope includes medical equipment retail, department stores, car rental, parking lot operations, and consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced building technologies including green building concepts, BIM (Building Information Modeling) technology, modular construction, and energy-saving designs. It implements rigorous quality control systems with three-tier quality assurance and standard operating procedures. The firm also integrates digital transformation and knowledge management to enhance product planning and customer service.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cathay serves primarily individual homebuyers and corporate clients in Taiwan's major metropolitan areas including Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. The customer base includes first-time homebuyers, self-use buyers, and investors, with a focus on residential and commercial real estate markets. The company also targets government and institutional clients through public urban renewal and redevelopment projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with business locations and projects concentrated in key metropolitan regions such as Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. It actively participates in urban renewal and land development projects across these areas and maintains multiple regional offices to support operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cathay operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, property development, construction management, and sales. It collaborates with upstream suppliers such as construction material providers and contractors, including its wholly owned subsidiary Mitsui Engineering, to manage construction and engineering services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development, digital transformation, and comprehensive quality management. It invests in R&D related to green building design, energy efficiency, seismic resistance, and smart building technologies. Cathay also focuses on expanding its land bank through diversified development strategies, including joint ventures and urban renewal projects, while enhancing brand value and customer service through data analytics and integrated group resources.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of residential and commercial properties, construction contract income, and rental income. Additional revenue streams include service fees from property management, consulting, and diversified investments in health management, hospitality, and retail sectors. The company also recognizes income from equity-method investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cathay is positioned as a leading real estate developer in Taiwan with a strong brand reputation, stable financial status, and professional R&D and construction capabilities. It competes with major local developers such as Farglory, Sinyi Realty, Far Eastern Construction, and others. The company differentiates itself through sustainable building practices, comprehensive after-sales service, and diversified business operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the latest fiscal year, Cathay reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$23.86 billion, representing a 54.12% increase from the prior year. Total assets reached about NT$89.4 billion with equity of NT$30.5 billion, reflecting steady growth. The company maintains a stable financial structure with increasing retained earnings and capital reserves, while managing liabilities prudently. Despite some fluctuations in net profit due to tax and cost factors, the overall financial trajectory is positive.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cathay emphasizes delivering 'real and reliable homes' with a focus on quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. Its value proposition includes clear property rights, construction according to plans, timely delivery, and ongoing service. The company integrates green building standards, digital technologies, and customer-centric design to meet diverse generational needs. Strong brand equity, rigorous quality control, and comprehensive after-sales support distinguish Cathay in the competitive real estate market.
